authority: External review approval (2026-07-22). Sealed by governance seal commit on the feat/quarantine-and-frontend-redesign branch. No further analytical or content revision was required after the P1D.0a/P1D.1a correction wave.
source_draft_evidence_description: Commit 0100935 (docs(p1d): complete P1D.0a/P1D.1a artifact package under docs/retrieval/) holds the draft (status: draft) evidence package that was verified by external review: all version markers v1.1, all statuses draft, held-out observed categories null, selection non-ceiling count 22, semantic-generalization count 2, observed embedding-indicated fraction 2/22, all-66 design priors, provenance/count assertions present, deterministic reruns, no production changes.
scope: This seal freezes the P1D.0 and P1D.1 artifacts. It does NOT select an architecture, authorize a candidate model, or change production retrieval. It closes P1D.0 and P1D.1 and authorizes P1D.2.

frozen_artifacts.description: Full SHA-256 hashes of all nine P1D artifacts in their FROZEN state (status: frozen). These hashes are post-freeze; they differ from the draft-state hashes in 0100935 because the status field changed from draft to frozen. The builder's two outputs (jsonl, distribution) are regenerated as frozen and remain deterministic across reruns.

gate_closures.P1D.0_closure_basis: Retrieval need spec, task-risk matrix, operational envelope, and slice-to-task-family map all frozen. Six task families defined with three-axis (objective/integrity/coverage) separation. Risk hierarchy separates globally-non-compensable (false_support) from task-hard-gated risks. Operational envelope split into diagnostic-host (provisional) and production-representative (to-be-set) with measurement protocols required.
gate_closures.P1D.1_closure_basis: Historical failure analysis frozen as characterization, NOT as an architecture decision. Observed selection evidence (44 cases, 22 non-ceiling) separated from held-out design priors (22 cases, observed categories null). Saturation arithmetic corrected: +0.030 macro gate is mathematically possible (max +0.0505; needs +0.060 on non-ceiling half) but the benchmark is partially saturated (50% at ceiling) with limited gate power. Slice classifications are design priors, not measured causal diagnoses.

declarations.architecture_selected_note: No retrieval architecture has been selected. P1D.0/P1D.1 establish needs and characterize the historical benchmark; they do not nominate or select any architecture.
declarations.candidate_model_authorized_note: No candidate embedding model is authorized. The historical data does not isolate embedding capacity as the dominant bottleneck, and no model has passed operational preflight (P1D.5, not yet run).
declarations.production_policy_changed_note: Production retrieval policy remains legacy_lexical_top20_v1, unchanged since P1B. No production code was modified in P1D.0/P1D.1 (git-verified: 0 tracked production files touched).

P1D.2_first_actions: Author 30-case diagnostic set drawn from known failure modes, weighted toward the three under-covered task families (evidence_retrieval, contradiction_retrieval, multi_paper_synthesis).
Author 48-case sealed product-validation set (8 per task family), at passage granularity for the three under-covered families.
Diagnostic set is visible during development; sealed set is hidden until one architecture is selected and frozen. No policy tuning on the sealed set.

boundaries_preserved.description: These three boundaries are binding and must not be violated by downstream waves. They prevent P1D.1 from being misread as a decision it does not make.
boundaries: P1D.1 does NOT conclude that lexical retrieval satisfies ERLab. The benchmark is partially saturated (50% at ceiling) and three of six task families are weakly/minimally covered. A 'lexical is sufficient' conclusion would be a false negative and is explicitly excluded.

P1D.1 does NOT authorize an embedding model. No candidate model is selected or authorized. The historical data does not isolate embedding capacity as the dominant bottleneck (only 2/22 observed non-ceiling cases have a semantic-generalization design hypothesis), and even that signal does not exonerate or indict embeddings.

P1D.1 establishes that NEW product-grounded evaluation evidence is required. The existing 66-case benchmark cannot answer the full product-wide needs-led question. P1D.2 (diagnostic + sealed sets at passage granularity) is load-bearing, not optional.

strategic_conclusion: The historical benchmark does not justify selecting a larger embedding model, and P1D.2 must establish the missing product-grounded evidence before any candidate architecture is nominated. This conclusion survived two rounds of external review (defect correction + provenance verification) unchanged.

verification_at_freeze.builder_deterministic_rerun: pass (identical SHA-256 across reruns for both builder outputs)
